lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice giving a short opinion with jag tycker att and one clear reason.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Talking about media habits, daily routines, or local services in a casual adult conversation.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Expressing a basic viewpoint and supporting it briefly.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss an everyday habit or service and give short opinions with simple reasons.

main_focus.name: opinion clauses with jag tycker att
main_focus.description: Use jag tycker att plus a simple clause to state an opinion, then add one reason.
model_examples: Jag tycker att appen är enkel att använda.
Jag tycker att det är bättre att åka tidigare eftersom det är lugnare.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use opinion clauses naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: reported speech as a separate grammar target

useful_chunks: För mig är det bättre att...
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use short adult opinion chunks and avoid abstract debate vocabulary.

dialogue_shape.opening: A familiar everyday topic is introduced with a simple opinion.
dialogue_shape.middle: They give reasons, partly agree or disagree, and compare the habit or service with another option.
dialogue_shape.ending: They summarize which view they lean toward and why.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat opinion frames while keeping turns conversational

focus: the main opinion in the conversation
the reason used to support the opinion
the point of partial agreement or contrast

sentence_focus: one sentence starting with jag tycker att
one sentence with för mig är det bättre att
one sentence expressing partial agreement with men
one sentence with det beror på situationen
